title: finding(types): `CollapsibleSchema.trigger` declares `string | SchemaNode` while its zod mirror, its shipped `defaultProps` and its docs row each spell a different accept set
body:
Found while implementing objectui#7081 (the overlay family's `trigger` widening). Fenced out of that PR on the dispatch's own terms: #7081 is scoped to `packages/types/src/overlay.ts`, and this member lives in `disclosure.ts`. Filed by the dev of `session_01BAZFhALsQsGqxui8sNqM8s`'s dispatch; measured on `origin/main` `737037f2`.

## The four spellings of one key

| where | what it says |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/types/src/disclosure.ts:97` | `trigger: string \| SchemaNode;` — a single node (or a bare string), **no array**; required |
| `packages/types/src/zod/disclosure.zod.ts:52` | `trigger: z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])` — **single or array**; required |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx:51` | `defaultProps.trigger: [{ type: 'button', label: 'Toggle', variant: 'outline' }]` — an **array**, against a declaration that refuses one |
| `content/docs/components/disclosure/collapsible.mdx:15` | `trigger: SchemaNode;` — matches **neither** face: the TS face also admits a bare `string`, the mirror also admits an array |

The runtime accepts both forms: `collapsible.tsx:25` hands `schema.trigger` to `renderChildren`, whose `Array.isArray` branch (`packages/components/src/lib/utils.tsx:23`) serves the array. An in-repo consumer already authors the array: `packages/components/src/__tests__/disabled-verdict-one-carrier.test.tsx:184` builds a `collapsible` node with `trigger: [{ type: 'text', content: 'Toggle' }]`.

The `string` half of the TS declaration is not a real extra either: `SchemaNode` already admits `string` (`base.ts`: `BaseSchema | string | number | boolean | null | undefined`), so `string | SchemaNode` collapses to `SchemaNode` and the spelling is redundant on top of being narrower than the mirror.

## Census: this is the only non-overlay `trigger` with the shape

Repo-wide grep for a `trigger` member declared at `SchemaNode` (with or without `string |`, with or without `?`) under `packages/types/src` after #7081: exactly one hit outside `overlay.ts`, this one. Every other `trigger` in the types package is a different affordance (`AccordionItem`'s title prose, chatbot `triggerSize` / retired `triggerIcon`, flow run triggers, tab trigger text).

## Why no gate catches it

Same blind spot #7081 recorded: `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` asserts one direction only (the mirror accepts everything the declaration declares), so a mirror wider than its declaration is allowed by construction. `check:doc-types` reads only `type` string literals out of doc code blocks, so the docs row can name any type and stay green.

## Options

(a) Widen the TS face to `SchemaNode | SchemaNode[]` (dropping the redundant `string |`), matching the mirror, the runtime, the shipped default and the overlay family after #7081, and re-derive the docs row — the same mechanical move triage ruled for #7081 (accept set does not move; the declaration stops under-reporting it). (b) Narrow the mirror and the `defaultProps` to singular — argued against by the same evidence as on #7081 (`renderChildren`'s array branch, a live in-repo array author).

Pinned as its filed premise: `packages/types/src/__tests__/overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts` carries `_CollapsibleStillSingular`, a type-level leg asserting the array is still refused on this member, so the day it widens that pin goes red and is re-derived deliberately.

Dedup: one targeted semantic search on this repository (both states) returned no card on `CollapsibleSchema.trigger`; the control query for the overlay shape returned #7081 first.

Refs: objectui#7081 · objectui#5684.

Written by the dev of `session_01BAZFhALsQsGqxui8sNqM8s`'s dispatch, via Claude Code (`https://claude.ai/code`).
